content.title: Image Shared daily micro-story
content.summary: A digitally mediated image-reference version of this activity.
content.setup: Invite the group, choose the first opening time, and use the package interval for later windows.
content.prompt: Write a short story inspired by an ordinary object.
content.participant: Submit one story in each open window. The group can read it immediately.
content.completion: All stories remain available in earlier windows. Missing entries do not block the next window.
content.access: Participants need text entry and reading access. The fixed interval is set in milliseconds and does not follow local calendar days.

provenance.rights: Illustrative package content; reuse terms have not been specified.
